title: Hearty Dutch Tempeh Casserole
description: This Dutch tempeh casserole is resinous and fluffy, with a rich Thai chili jam glaze. Cooked in a clay pot, it delivers a high-protein, comforting dish for any meal.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, and Thai chili jam.
Toss tempeh cubes in the sauce mixture, letting them marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat a clay pot over medium heat, add a splash of water, and sauté onions until translucent.
Add carrots, bell pepper, and marinated tempeh to the pot; stir for 5 minutes.
Pour remaining water, bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until vegetables tender.
Increase heat to high, stir in 2 tbsp of Thai chili jam, and let the sauce reduce, coating the casserole.
Transfer the clay pot to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes to tighten the glaze.
Remove from oven, sprinkle chopped parsley, and let rest 5 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally with a side of rice or crusty bread.
